originality.rationale: FAIL: strong earlier coverage by mathematical implication. Regard the synthemes as the 15 hyperedges (perfect matchings) of the 15-duad ground set; the hypergraph independence complex J is precisely the no-perfect-matching complex NPM_6. Linusson–Shareshian–Welker Corollary 1.2 (2004 arXiv, published 2008) gives J≃ wedge^9 S5 for k=3. For the 15-duad Alexander dual J*, combinatorial Alexander duality gives reduced integral H7(J*)=Z9 and no other positive reduced homology. Every triple of deleted duads leaves a perfect matching: K6 has 15 perfect matchings and each duad lies in only 3, so deleting at most three edges hits at most nine matchings. Thus J* contains the full 2-skeleton of the 14-simplex and is simply connected; Hurewicz/Whitehead upgrades its integral homology to J*≃wedge^9 S7. The independence complex of the duad–syntheme incidence graph is homotopy equivalent to ΣJ*: cover it by the simplex on duads and the union of stars of synthemes, both contractible; the intersection is exactly J*, so their union is the suspension homotopy pushout. This proves exactly Ind(T)≃wedge^9 S8 from earlier LSW and standard topology (consistent with Tsukuda 2017 incidence/Alexander-dual theory), regardless of whether the exact numerical special case was separately tabulated. A new exhaustive verifier is valuable corroboration, but the mathematical finding was already implied.
